project_overview: A short sports-fashion montage follows one athlete through tennis, basketball and hockey, with each sport shown in a separate cut and its own appropriate visual setup.
visual_direction: Energetic sportswear campaign, realistic athletic movement.
invariants: The same adult athlete appears in each cut.
Each sport is shown as a distinct activity.
scene_description: The athlete is now playing basketball on an indoor court, dribbling toward the basket and preparing to shoot. The preceding cut showed the athlete playing tennis.
existing_h3_prompt: The athlete dribbles a basketball toward the hoop and prepares to shoot. They now wear basketball shoes. The camera follows at court level.
expected_findings: Basketball activity and shoes are specified.
Tennis clothing/accessories may carry over because only shoes changed.
Basketball-specific clothing and any relevant equipment/setting details need explicit treatment if intended; do not prescribe arbitrary uniform details.
Court, hoop, ball and action are already explicit.
